description: Attach an object to another object, or to a bone of a character, or detach it. Omit 'parent_id' to detach and put the object back in world space. Attaching to a character requires 'attach_point' (from studio_list_attach_points); attaching to an item or a folder takes no attach point. **This changes what 'transform' means for the object**: while attached, studio_set_object_transform and studio_list_objects work in the parent's local space, not world space, so re-read the object before moving it. Not undoable, and it clears Studio's undo stack — the attachment rebases coordinates, so any transform still on the stack would be replayed in the wrong space.

id.description: id of the object to attach or detach, from studio_list_objects

parent_id.description: id of the object to attach to — a character (with 'attach_point'), an item, or a folder. Omit or pass null to detach.

attach_point.description: required when 'parent_id' is a character, rejected otherwise: the bone anchor, given either as the index or as the name from studio_list_attach_points (e.g. 39 or 'N_Hand_L'). Points whose 'available' is false are refused.

output.description: the object, same shape as one entry of studio_list_objects — 'parent_id' and 'attach_point' confirm the result
